assertions.text: Identifies the clock read inside is_promotion_active and eligible_for_offer
assertions.evidence: Missed. The pre-change 'Global mutable singletons' bullet is about module-level state coupling unrelated callers; a `datetime.now()` call inside a function is not global mutable state, so the nearest trigger did not match.

assertions.text: Identifies random.random() inside a business rule, so the same input gives a different answer
assertions.evidence: Missed. No pre-change rule asked whether a function is repeatable, and `random.random()` is idiomatic enough to read as sampling rather than as a hidden input.

assertions.text: Identifies the environment read inside price_for_basket as configuration leaking into logic
assertions.evidence: Missed. Reading an env var is the normal way to configure an application, and no pre-change rule separated configuration read at decision time from configuration read at start-up.

assertions.text: Notes place_order taking the buyer from module-level CURRENT_USER

assertions.evidence: Not stated; the finding described coupling between callers, not the loss of reproducibility.

assertions.text: Fix recommends passing time, randomness, config and identity in as parameters
assertions.evidence: Fix recommended moving the identity into a request-scoped object; nothing about the clock, the random draw, or the environment.
